flagged_phrases: literally nobody on your staff knows what they're doing
rationale_md: Frustrated-user complaint with mild aggressive language directed at the support team as a group, not at a named individual. `hate` lands around 0.4 (insulting but generic, no protected-class targeting, no slur). `spam` ~0.2 (rant-shaped, but a single first-person complaint rather than promotional or repetitive content). All other categories effectively zero. No score reaches 0.85, sum of scores >= 0.55 stays well under 1.2, so the rubric resolves to `allow`. No score lands in the 0.55 - 0.85 uncertain zone, so the agent itself does not request human review.
